description: This file defines template classes for tensor accessors used in CPU and CUDA contexts within the PyTorch framework. It includes classes for managing tensor data pointers, sizes, and strides, with support for device-specific optimizations and transpositions.

classes.name: TensorAccessorBase
classes.description: Base class template for tensor accessors, managing data pointers, sizes, and strides for both CPU and CUDA tensors.

classes.name: TensorAccessor
classes.description: Template class for tensor accessors, supporting multidimensional indexing and slicing for CPU and CUDA tensors.

classes.name: GenericPackedTensorAccessorBase
classes.description: Base class for packed tensor accessors, copying sizes and strides for device transfer, with bounds checking.

classes.name: GenericPackedTensorAccessor
classes.description: Template class for packed tensor accessors, supporting multidimensional indexing, transposition, and device transfer.

classes.name: HeaderOnlyIndexBoundsCheck
classes.description: Bounds check class for tensor dimensions, used in header-only tensor accessors.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns the sizes of the tensor as an array reference.

methods.name: strides
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor as an array reference.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides element access for tensors, supporting multidimensional indexing.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns a transposed view of the tensor by swapping two dimensions.
